title: The Nature of Divine Vision
english: Another introductory remark: there are many gods and many lords in heaven and on earth, but the gods are not idols or demons, but rather those to whom the maker of them became [related]. If the Word of God becomes toward men, men become god-makers... [gaps]... when the Word of God was seen... [gaps]... It is said, therefore, of gods... [gaps]... according to 'The Lord spoke among gods' (Psalm 89:1), clearly meaning those who are gods by participation... [gaps]... of the makers... [gaps]... and the one seen... [gaps]... the Lord was named... [gaps]... not [himself] but 'You, the God who grants me'... [gaps]... god-making... [gaps]... And that which is the sincere part of the vision brought [it] forward: 'And indeed it was seen before me' (Job 1:6), and it is clear that not with fleshly eyes but with the intellect, as it has been said: 'Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God' (Matthew 5:8); for He is manifested to those not believing in Him. For God provides Himself for contemplation through goodness, the created nature being unable to see Him unless He grants Himself for contemplation according to the proportion of each one's faith.

And also the written vessel says: 'Because of this the vessel called, Vessel before whom I saw' [gaps]... for a vessel is the understanding of those things which are fitting; for the name... [gaps]... is often taken upon the intelligible: 'Drink waters from your vessels and from your cisterns the springs' (Proverbs 5:15). The beginning of the... [gaps]... the flowing insights are the cisterns of the spring, which is the correct conception concerning God, the cisterns being the divine words. And also the vision of the teacher's word having been seen 'between Kadish and between Barad' (Ezekiel 1:4) is well interpreted; for Kadish is interpreted as holy, and Barad as lightning. In the midst, therefore, of this holy [one]... [gaps]... and in the midst of lightning, of a luminous state, the instruction is...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
